messages:
jamie: Quick follow-up from the nightly profiler after the kernel-affinity change. Seeing ~8-12% p50 regression on short-generator workloads. Traces point to prefill/decode interleaving causing KV cache evictions and small-batch kernel choices that have higher setup overhead. Dumping quick notes + configs I used.

jamie: profiler snippet:
```
prefill_p50: 18.2ms (was 14.1ms)
decode_p50: 9.1ms (was 6.3ms)
kv_miss_rate: 9.3% (was 2.0%)
small_batch_kernel_hits: +45%
```

alex: Can you paste the flamegraph or kernel selection log? :eyes:

jamie: kernel log excerpt:
```
[2024-03-10T03:12:45Z] select_kernel(model=redwood-7b, batch=3, seq=32) -> cuda_opt_v2 (setup 1.4ms)
[2024-03-10T03:12:45Z] select_kernel(model=redwood-7b, batch=16, seq=32) -> cuda_opt_v1 (setup 0.2ms)
```

maria: sounds like the selector's fixed cost is penalizing microbatches post-split. Could we bias the selector by phase? i.e., prefer low-setup kernels for decode path and keep cuda_opt_v2 for prefill.

sam: Also KV thrash — prefill writes are racing decode reads because we don't pin hot entries during handshake. Two ideas: 1) small prefill soft-lock window (hold KV entry for 50ms after prefill), 2) token-budget nudges to encourage slightly larger prefill batches so kernel amortizes.

jamie: agree. quick experiment config I pushed to staging:
```
phase_split:
  prefill_pref: 'bundle'
  prefill_min_tokens: 32
  prefill_hold_ms: 50
  decode_min_tokens: 1
kernel_bias:
  decode_prefer_low_setup: true
token_budget:
  target_per_request: 256
```
Applied to canary group id=alpha.

alex: How do we measure effect? Look at kv_miss_rate, setup_time, and end-to-end p50. Also watch tail latencies for bursty rps.

jamie: ran 30m canary. kv_miss_rate dropped to 3.1% on canary, prefill_p50 back to 15ms, decode_p50 6.8ms. Small regressed samples still show setup spikes when we get single-request microbatches. Need queue policy change.

maria: maybe implement a soft-demux: hold small decode requests for up to 8ms to aggregate if there's a prefill window. gives decode slightly higher chance to join existing batch.

sam: risk is added latency for single-request low-latency workloads. We can gate soft-demux behind request SLA: only aggregate if client SLO >= 100ms.

jamie: good caveat. I'll add SLO gate and run another canary. Also logging change to emit kernel_choice per request for 1% sample.

infra-bot: deploy: rolled canary config to infra/alpha on 1719023500 by @jamie :rocket:

ops-bot: monitor: anomaly detector flagged slight tail bump in region eu-west-1 after config rollout — investigating.

alex: nit: add a counter for 'kv_pin_hits' to validate prefill_hold_ms effectiveness.

jamie: added. next steps: run 2-hour canary with soft-demux+SLO gate, collect kernel_choice logs, plot kv_pin_hits, kv_miss_rate, and p50/p95. tagging @maria @sam for follow-up.
